title: Resolution urging Albany to delay court dates for late-stage pregnancy
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, legislation postponing court proceedings for people who are seven months pregnant or further along, until three months after childbirth, absent extraordinary circumstances. It follows a widely reported incident in which a pregnant person gave birth in a Brooklyn courtroom while awaiting arraignment. The proposal would also allow courts to use alternative procedures to preserve legal rights while minimizing in-person appearances.
